response.justification: The candidate is a strong generalist full-stack engineer with deep TypeScript/Node.js and DLang experience, but does not meet the core requirements of this role. C++ exposure is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a bachelor thesis project, far short of the 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++ required. There is no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience (RIDE Capital was a fintech startup for investment administration, not capital markets), and no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle depth.
strengths: Broad, versatile engineering background across web, backend, and low-latency systems (DLang, Node.js)
Solid engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, DevOps tooling
Excellent communication skills, demonstrated through workshops, talks, and teaching
concerns: Minimal professional C++ experience (~7 months, a decade ago), nowhere near the mandatory 5–10 years
No fixed income, derivatives, capital markets, or investment banking domain knowledge
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle experience; database background is MongoDB/MySQL

key_factors.factor: No capital markets / fixed income domain expertise
Strong general engineering fundamentals and CI/CD knowledge
